title: Section C SC-21: the database path resolves against the current working directory (unset DB_PATH and the shipped DB_PATH=./data/bot.db alike), and db.ts creates the folder and an empty database when none is there, so starting from another directory boots on a fresh database: kill-switch off, open positions not resumed, dedup and loss history empty

evidence.note: const DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(process.cwd(), 'data', 'bot.db'): both the default and any relative value depend on the cwd
mkdirSync(dbDir, { recursive: true }) then new Database(DB_PATH): a missing file is created silently
the template ships DB_PATH=./data/bot.db (relative), so a copied .env keeps the cwd dependence
a fresh database gets pause_state seeded with paused = 0 (kill-switch off)
the restart scan reads only rows in the database it opened; an empty one resumes nothing

sibling_sites_checked: Other cwd-relative state in the slice: migrateJsonState reads cwd/.bot-state.json (db.ts:242, AUD-DB-019). Any process importing db.ts from another cwd creates its own data/bot.db there (preflight, pause, resume scripts, the dashboard via bot.ts). The 22-09 rail anchors DB_PATH to the repo root (nearest package.json named crypto-snipe-bot) and refuses to create a database outside Vitest except through npm run db:init (D-08); 22-29 re-audits that diff.
severity_rationale: S1 STRAND: a plausible operator slip (starting the bot from a subfolder, an IDE run configuration or a scheduled task with another working directory) gives a bot that is unpaused even if the operator had paused it, monitors none of the positions the wallet holds (no exits, no anti-rug), may re-buy tokens it already holds and starts with an empty daily-loss history, all without an error. Mitigated by the 22-09 rail; status stays confirmed until 22-29 verifies it.
recommendation: Mitigated by the planned 22-09 rail (repo-root anchoring of DB_PATH, refuse-to-create outside Vitest, explicit npm run db:init). 22-29 re-audits the db.ts diff; also change the .env.example line to an absolute path or remove it (D-ENV-EXAMPLE).

triage.note: Re-measured on the real src/utils/db.ts outside Vitest (railed children) from another working folder with a relative DB_PATH (AUD-DB-007.test.ts): it opens the repo-anchored operator database (paused, one open buy), refuses a missing one with DB_REFUSED_MISSING naming the anchored absolute path, creates nothing anywhere, and an unset or ./data/bot.db DB_PATH resolves to <repo root>/data/bot.db; nothing of the finding remains; the cwd .bot-state.json import stays its own finding AUD-DB-019
